summary: First draft of ADR-002: editor, board face, diagram:scene, conversation session and review store as five groups, with the numbered order of the design — post, session action, port start/send/queue, deltas forwarded on the one events stream, respond write, stamp move, re-read replacing the live turn.
rationale: The brief asks for a sequence across five participants; the aof profile is flowchart-only, so each participant is a group and the order is carried by numbered edge labels (1–8). Dotted edges are the return paths (the session answer, the streamed deltas, the stamp event); the thick edge is the single SSE connection, the point of the ADR (no second stream). The review store is outlined in the accent colour because the record stays the thread’s one home. No library item fits (the libraries are AWS icons). No ADR amendment is implied.
